title: Newhalo media slot
description: A frame that crops an image or video like object-fit: cover; empty, it is a plain muted panel or a soft glow wash of the same size and shape. Takes an inner class so blocks can drift the picture inside the frame on scroll.
notes: give the frame its size, aspect ratio and radius through className
name: newhalo-media

props.name: children
props.description: the real image or video; it is cropped to the frame like object-fit: cover. Empty shows the placeholder.

props.name: tone
props.description: placeholder surface: muted (a quiet token-coloured panel), deep (the darker card colour), glow (a soft highlight-to-glow wash, for art slots) or warm (a full highlight-to-glow gradient, for orange photography)

props.name: className
props.description: size, aspect ratio and radius of the frame, e.g. "aspect-square rounded-lg"

props.name: innerClassName
props.description: classes for the inner layer, e.g. a scroll-driven parallax class
